es: Todo el complejo hizo un round-trip violento en Londres: barrida de minimos (NQ bajo el low semanal, ES bajo su PDL, CL bajo 90.45) seguida de un reclamo fuerte que dejo el sesgo de sesion en NEUTRAL en los cinco -- nadie tiene permiso de sesion limpio para NY todavia.

NQ: sin sesgo, WAIT, la barrida bajo el low semanal (28927 vs 28946.75) y el reclamo hasta el cluster POC/VAH es la senal de agotamiento vendedor mas fuerte hasta ahora -- tesis EVOLVING, conviccion baja.
ES: corto, WAIT, la mas limpia: rozo el pullback 7659-7667 por 1 tick sin tocarlo tras la barrida bajo 7621.50 -- zona aun virgen.
GC: sin sesgo, WAIT, ni se acerco al 4o test de 4383-4424 -- ojo, el sesgo fusionado marca LISTO LARGO pero drbias dice explicitamente no perseguir, estirado casi 3 ATR, es trampa.

YM: sin sesgo, WAIT, confirmo la divergencia: rompio y sostuvo sobre la invalidacion del corto (52885, llego a 53020) -- el corto de la noche murio, pero esta muy estirado (2.9 ATR) para perseguir el largo sin pullback.

CL: AVOID, tesis de fondo rota -- perdio el low overnight de referencia (90.45) antes de llegar al inventario EIA de las 09:30 CT; estirado 4.2 ATR y con el catalizador real todavia por venir, no fuerces nada de ningun lado hasta despues del dato.
limite diario $1000: en NQ el stop es angosto (maxContracts 1 en la zona A+); en ES/GC un full contract sigue intocable con esos stops (maxContracts 0), revisa micros; en YM maxContracts 1.

Ejecucion (2 dias, agregado de cuenta, sin desglose por instrumento): 42% de los trades fueron contra el sesgo del plan y 21% fuera de zona, con un dia de churn (sobreoperar+revenge+roundtrip) el 09-01 -- si hoy sale WAIT en varios instrumentos, es la senal de dejar pasar, no de forzar en el instrumento que sea.
en: The whole complex made a violent round-trip in London: a sweep of the lows (NQ below the weekly low, ES below its PDL, CL below 90.45) followed by a hard reclaim that left session bias at NEUTRAL across all five -- nobody has clean session permission for NY yet.
NQ: no clear bias, WAIT, the sweep below the weekly low (28927 vs 28946.75) and the reclaim into the POC/VAH cluster is the strongest seller-exhaustion signal yet -- thesis EVOLVING, conviction low.
ES: short, WAIT, the cleanest one: grazed the 7659-7667 pullback by 1 tick without tagging it after the sweep below 7621.50 -- zone still untested.
GC: no clear bias, WAIT, didn't even get close to the 4th test of 4383-4424 -- watch out, the fused bias flags READY LONG but drbias explicitly says don't chase, stretched almost 3 ATR, it's a trap.

YM: no clear bias, WAIT, confirmed the divergence: broke and held above the short's invalidation (52885, reached 53020) -- tonight's short is dead, but it's very stretched (2.9 ATR) to chase the long without a pullback.

CL: AVOID, the underlying thesis broke -- lost the reference overnight low (90.45) before reaching the 09:30 CT EIA inventory report; stretched 4.2 ATR with the real catalyst still ahead, don't force either side until after the print.
$1000 daily limit: NQ's stop is tight (maxContracts 1 on the A+ zone); in ES/GC a full contract is still untouchable at those stops (maxContracts 0), check micros; YM maxContracts 1.

Execution (2 days, account-level aggregate, no per-instrument breakdown): 42% of trades went against the plan's bias and 21% traded outside a mapped zone, with one churn day (overtrading+revenge+round-trips) on 09-01 -- if several instruments read WAIT today, that's the signal to sit out, not to force the one that's left.

Resolucion: lo mantengo pero degrado (segunda vez). La estructura de 1h/4h y el marco fusionado siguen tecnicamente cortos, pero la conviccion baja a baja: sin un rechazo limpio en el cluster alto, no hay edge para vender aqui, y si rompe y sostiene sobre 29144 hay que soltar el corto de la sesion.
counterCase.en: the sweep below the weekly low followed by such a hard reclaim, plus YM's bullish divergence and the NQ/ES bullish SMT, is classic seller-exhaustion territory -- if this is the end of the 2-day downtrend, NY should break and hold above the POC/VAH/disc25 cluster (~29108-29144) with real follow-through, not just a wick. Resolution: I'm keeping it but downgrading (second time). The 1h/4h structure and the fused frame stay technically short, but conviction drops to low: without a clean rejection at the high cluster there's no edge to sell here, and a break-and-hold above 29144 means dropping the session short.

reason.en: no real A+ in sight: price sits below the POC/VAH cluster (29108-29144, B-tier confluence) without having tagged it yet, and the NQ/ES bullish SMT argues against front-running the short there -- wait for a confirmed rejection or a sustained break below 29002 with a retest, don't buy the short just because the underlying bias stays bearish

El sesgo fusionado paso de FUERTE corto a NEUTRAL/DEBIL (-3) y el precio quedo en zona de no-trade del propio indicador (29033-29078). La estructura de 1h/4h sigue bajista, pero el marco semanal crudo nunca giro del todo y ahora la barrida+reclamo es la evidencia mas fuerte de agotamiento vendedor de los ultimos 2 dias.

The fused bias flipped from STRONG short to NEUTRAL/WEAK (-3) and price sits in the indicator's own no-trade zone (29033-29078). The 1h/4h structure stays bearish, but the raw weekly frame never fully flipped and now the sweep-plus-reclaim is the strongest seller-exhaustion evidence of the last 2 days.

Resolution: I'm keeping it. The 7659-7667 zone is still the index's best technical read (profile+ONH/IBH pivot+FVG+MTF), but the self-check counts: if the next rejection also isn't clean, the underlying bias needs a real review, not just another downgrade.

counterCase.en: the fused bias says LOOKING FOR LONG with active session permission, but that collides head-on with the bias-by-zone source explicitly saying 'expensive/cheap, don't chase' and with the HTF frame flagging weekly/daily/1h/4h bearish with no exception -- if the fused signal is right and this is the start of a real recovery, GC should break and hold above 4391 (ONH) with follow-through before the short makes sense again at any level. Resolution: I'm keeping it but downgrading. The fused signal is contradicted by 3 raw sources (the bias-by-zone source + 2 HTF frames) and its own stretch (2.97 ATR, VERY STRETCHED) makes the long signal a classic chase trap -- that long doesn't get traded. The underlying short still stands, but without a real 4th test yet there's nothing to sell either.
